_readme: THE NAMED PLACEMENT-RULE LIBRARY (owner directive, 2026-08-18): rules are
'custom authored and defined prior', then ATTACHED to species by name, one
or many per (species, biome), via the spec's `biome_rules` block. A rule is
a masked set of placement restrictions; attaching several composes them by
INTERSECTION (strictest wins) -- see docs/placement-spec-schema.md for the
per-field law and the exact clamp ranges.
Fields a rule may carry (all optional, at least one required):
elev_min_m, elev_max_m   metres above sea level (band intersects)
slope_min_pct, slope_max_pct  percent grade 0-70 (band intersects)
water_max_m              only within this distance of water (min wins)
water                    one of any/ocean/river/lake/shallow/reef
('lake' = fresh only -- the owner's 'near fresh
water body'; 'river' = fresh+brackish)
spacing_m                minimum spacing (max wins; never moves the layer)
abundance                0..1 frequency (min wins)
cluster                  0..1 grove strength (setters must agree)
Renaming or deleting a rule that any spec references makes the export
REFUSE by name -- a typo'd reference must never silently drop a restriction.
Editing a rule's numbers changes the manifest: worldgen change, version
bump, goldens re-blessed.

near-fresh-water-60m._note: The owner's worked example: a temperate-type tree in a desert must sit near a fresh water body. Attach to (species, desert).

near-fresh-water-25m._note: Tighter oasis margin: reeds and water-edge flowers in arid biomes.

near-water-100m._note: Riparian corridor at valley scale, any salinity.

sparse-outlier._note: A species present but rare and scattered: relict trees, lone specimens at a biome's edge.

scree-band._note: Only on steep ground: talus and cliff-fall debris must vanish from lawns.

valley-floor._note: Lowland-only in this biome, whatever the species' default band says.

no-cluster._note: Scatter evenly in this biome even if the species usually grows in stands.
